The emotes are incredibly cute, and I would love to commission several of them for my community.

I’m interested in the following emotes:
85, 84, 82, 80, 79, 69, 59, 58, 54, 42, 35, 33, 27, 14, 13, 11, 09, 02, 15, 53, 52

Since this would be quite a large order, I would really appreciate it if you could consider adjusting the price if possible.

Here are reference materials for the characters (multiple):
https://imgur.com/a/dyw4DYT
https://postimg.cc/gallery/7yWPRTR

For each emote, please be sure to use multiple different characters. Rather than reusing just one character, feel free to choose whichever characters best suit each emote. Please choose the three characters shown in the first image rather than the one with the fully covered face, as I believe the latter may be too difficult to work with.

I understand that it can be difficult to depict expressions while wearing a balaclava, but please do not remove the mask. Many artists draw the mouth area in black on top of the balaclava, and I think that approach looks great.

Thank you very much.

多くのアーティストが、バラクラバの上に口元を黒く描く表現をしていますが、その方法はとても良いと思っています。
